# `validate_utf8`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the original string if `str` is a valid UTF-8 string, otherwise throws an exception.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
validate_utf8(str)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- validate_utf8, example 1
> SELECT validate_utf8('Spark');
Spark
```

```sql
-- validate_utf8, example 2
> SELECT validate_utf8(x'61');
a
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
